title: Running Total
prompt: Return an array where each position contains the sum of all numbers up to and including that position.

explanation.beginner:
Example: runningTotal([1,2,3,4]) produces [1,3,6,10]. Choose the numeric contribution of each record, then combine those contributions using the contract’s initial value.

Compare “includes negative numbers”: input [[5,-2,7]] produces [5,3,10]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Choose the numeric contribution of each record, then combine those contributions using the contract’s initial value.

Tempting mistake: A count of records is not a sum of their values. Test empty input and a zero-valued record separately.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “includes negative numbers”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
